description: Central Band of Sri Lanka - Order to repealed the Notices under the Exchange Control Act, No. 24 of  1953 by the Controller of Exchange
reasoning: This gazette content announces the repeal of notifications made under the Foreign Exchange Act and the Exchange Control Act. It deals with the modification of existing legal/regulatory frameworks (specifically financial regulations), which falls squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). The notice is issued by a government official but does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities, so government types (1-3) do not apply.
